title: Owner: look at the graph and try one drag
goal: The owner sees the graph in both looks and one reorder ends as a PR or a refusal
acceptance: On NERV-01 after the update, open the full dashboard, the "Work across projects" card, then the Graph view. Expected: lanes by who acts, one chain marked "critical" with the hours of slack on the other steps, each node linked to its file; the lane switch regroups by repository
Switch Theme to Eva. Expected: the same graph as a skill tree, locked, available and done steps told apart by shape and word; switch to Simple: the plain look returns

Drag one step past an independent step in its lane and approve. Expected: a PR link in voidbrain/coordinator changing only docs/solution-order.md (do not merge it unless you want the new order). Then drag a step past one it depends on. Expected: the step snaps back and the card says "X depends on Y"
Resize to phone width (or open on the phone). Expected: the text list replaces the drawing
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no personal data, tokens or private reports in Git.
validation: Owner check, recorded in F-160 Verification
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Two screens and one drag on the Mac. Estimated 2026-11-27. Not a measurement.
